title: Getting started
body:
# Getting started

Create your marina, import your berth list, and send your first quarterly invoices.

1. Add the marina as an organization.
2. Import berths from a spreadsheet.
3. Review the generated invoices and send them.
summary: From an empty account to the first quarterly invoice run.

title: Importing berths from a spreadsheet
body:
# Importing berths

Export your berth list as CSV with one row per berth. Map the berth code to the product SKU and the holder's email to the person.
summary: Map a berth list onto products and berth holders.

title: I did not receive my sign-in link
body: Check your spam folder first. If the link is not there after five minutes, request a new one; links expire after fifteen minutes and only the newest one works.
summary: What to do when a sign-in link does not arrive.
